part.text: Root cause: `removeSheetByIndex` sets `activeSheetIndex` to -1 when removing the last sheet, but `addSheet` with an explicit index only increments it (never resets a negative value), leaving -1 as the active index. Fix in `addSheet`:

part.text:
All failures are pre-existing environment issues (GD images, fonts, samples) — none related to sheets or my change.

**Fix**: In `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Spreadsheet.php` (`addSheet`), when a sheet is added at an explicit index, a negative `activeSheetIndex` (left by `removeSheetByIndex` on the last remaining sheet) is now clamped to 0 before the increment check. Previously `-1 >= 0` failed so the index stayed -1, and any subsequent style application via `setActiveSheetIndex(-1)` threw "sheet index -1 is out of bounds".

Verified: the issue's reproduction now works, and `SpreadsheetTest` (27 tests), `Worksheet`/`Cell` suites plus the full `tests/PhpSpreadsheetTests` run show only pre-existing failures.
